'''Galaar Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit and was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Galaar [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] was one of the few [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squads that were not trained by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], having been trained instead by a [[Unidentified Corellian Cuy'val Dar instructor|Corellian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Cuy'val Dar]]. After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Galaar Squad was disbanded and two of its surviving members, [[Bry (clone trooper)|Bry]] and [[Ennen|IC-4447]], nicknamed "Ennen", joined [[Omega Squad]]'s [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Darman Skirata]] to form [[Squad 40]].<ref name="IC 501st" />
